verdict.rationale: Eqvista offers its own in-house 409A valuations performed by NACVA-certified analysts, bundled with the premium cap table and including unlimited valuations for 12 months (which covers refreshes) plus paid expedite options. It also documents a real-time, app-based common stock valuation view and menu. However, the evidence never shows an in-platform ordering flow, never states that the 409A is generated from the live cap table data, and never describes an automated refresh schedule. Missing for 10: documented in-platform 409A ordering workflow, explicit generation from live cap table data, scheduled/automatic refresh cadence, independent or hands-on corroboration of audit-readiness.
